description: IDProtect is a cryptographic module based on the Athena OS755 Java Card 2.2.2 and GlobalPlatform2. 1.1 specifications and F IPS 140-2 Level 3 (Level 4 for physical security).IDProtect supports F IPS approved Random Number Generator, TDES,A ES, SHA-I, SHA-256, and RSA up to 2048 bits including on board key generation.
